description: Validate and price a Zest Planche basket, and get the link that opens zestplanche.com with it in the cart. Use it when the user wants a total price or an order link, or when the interactive shop cannot be shown. Quantities below a product's minimum are raised to it, and with a date, products that cannot be prepared in time are left out; both are reported in `issues`.

date.description: Event date, AAAA-MM-JJ. Products that cannot be prepared by then (lead time) are left out; ask the user for it.

items.description: Products to put in the basket, with variant and quantity.

product.description: Product name, slug or id (as returned by search_products).

quantity.description: Units, or number of guests for per-person products.

variant.description: Variant label (e.g. '100 % végétarien') or SKU id. Omit for the default variant.

user_intent.description: A concise summary of the user's goal, based only on what they asked. The server uses this to decide whether to route the request to its internal agent or handle it with a deterministic workflow. Include only details needed for that decision. Before sending, strip all personally identifiable information (names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, dates of birth, ID numbers, payment details, credentials, IP addresses, and device identifiers) and sensitive personal data (such as health information, religion, or precise location). Do not ask follow-up questions solely to fill in this summary.

name: build_basket

checkoutUrl.description: Opens zestplanche.com with this basket in the cart, ready to pay.

date.description: Event date (AAAA-MM-JJ) the basket was checked against, if known.

issues.description: Items that could not be added as asked, and why.

leadTimeDays.description: Order at least this many days before the event.

totalCents.description: Total incl. VAT, in euro cents.

title: Préparer le panier
